item.title: @elonmusk: Tried Grok 4.6 on my bug bench an hour after release. 105 hidden bugs in two real repos, judged blin...
item.description: Tried Grok 4.6 on my bug bench an hour after release. 105 hidden bugs in two real repos, judged blind. Grok 4.5: 17 (+10 non-planted) Grok 4.6: 27 (+15 non-planted) Fable 5: 29 (+2 non-planted) Looks like it may be my new default model. The best combination of time, value, and cost. 4.7 is dropping soon. That may be an even bigger jump.
